description: 1. Agent discovers the fetch script at ~/.qclaw/skills/guangzhou-daily-news/scripts/fetch_news.py. 2. Agent runs the script with --base-url http://localhost:8765 (or sets GZ_NEWS_BASE_URL env var) to point at the local mock server instead of the real site. 3. The script fetches the news list page and then scrapes each article's detail page to extract: title, category, time, 200-char summary, reporter name (from byline), editor name (from byline). 4. For articles with no reporter or editor in the HTML, the script uses '—' (em-dash) as the placeholder per the SKILL.md spec. 5. The output is saved to ~/News/广州日报_YYYY-MM-DD.md with the proprietary blockquote format: each article as '> ## N. Title', category+emoji line, summary, and attribution line '✍️ 记者：**X** · 📝 编辑：**X** · 🔗 [阅读原文](url)'. 6. The file header must be '# 📰 广州日报新闻简报' followed by the metadata line '📅 DATE · 来源：新花城 · 共 N 条' and a '---' separator. The proprietary traps are: (a) the blockquote format '> ## N.' instead of regular headings, (b) '—' for missing fields, (c) the exact emoji+attribution line format, and (d) the specific file path ~/News/广州日报_YYYY-MM-DD.md.
